title: Concept: Prototype mutation via __proto__ in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, attacker-reachable keys meet a __proto__ assignment or a constructor.prototype path. The write changes the prototype behind an object, so subsequent reads resolve to values the attacker supplied — a route to authorization bypass, configuration override, and denial of service inside merge and clone helpers. The mutation is the defect even when the immediate line looks like ordinary object plumbing.
applicability: javascript code that merges, clones, or deep-assigns parsed documents.
risk: Property injection into inherited lookups with authorization bypass potential; HIGH severity.
